description: The file defines the Message class within the Goteo project, responsible for representing, retrieving, and managing message objects, including functionalities for fetching messages, responses, participants, recipients, and related data. It encapsulates message-related data and behavior for the application, including database interactions.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Represents messages within the application, providing methods to access message data, manage conversations, associations with users and projects, and database operations related to messages.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a message by its ID, including associated user and responses.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all message threads for a specific project with optional filters and ordering.

methods.name: getUserThreads
methods.description: Fetches message threads associated with a specific user, with filtering options.

methods.name: getUserMessages
methods.description: Obtains messages addressed to a specific user, possibly filtered by project.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a message by ID, handling associated responses if applicable.

methods.name: isSupport
methods.description: Checks if a message thread is marked as support.

methods.name: numMessengers
methods.description: Counts the number of messengers involved in a project.

methods.name: getMessengers
methods.description: Returns a list of messengers involved in a project.

methods.name: getMesseged
methods.description: Lists projects in which a user has participated via messages.
